name: Feather, the Redeemed
description:
{"ops":[{"attributes":{"bold":true},"insert":"Gameplan"},{"attributes":{"header":3},"insert":"
"},{"insert":"Use cantrips to cycle through deck as fast as possible. Do not be too greedy and keep enough mana open to protect Feather once or twice. Gameplay feels a bit like spellslinger, triggering abilities on each instant / sorcery. Main way of winning is through combat damage using (buffed) tokens. Sometimes feather can do enough commander damage, but this is rarely the case.

"},{"attributes":{"bold":true},"insert":"Opening Hand"},{"attributes":{"header":3},"insert":"
"},{"insert":"A decent starting hand has 3 Lands + 1 Mana Rock. Additional Protection Spells / Cantrips are bonus. Don't be afraid to mulligan to 6 or 5 cards. Once the deck gets rolling there is more than enough card draw to catch up. Here is an example how an opening can look like.

Turn 1: Land

Turn 2: Land + Mana Rock

Turn 3: Land + Feather + Protection Spell open

Turn 4: More Ramp / draw with cantrips / value engines / interaction

"},{"attributes":{"bold":true},"insert":"Wincons explained"},{"attributes":{"header":3},"insert":"
"},{"insert":"Akroan Conscriptor: Not a wincon itself, but stealing creatures to either block or attack makes it very annoying for opponents and usually puts the board on the clock. Bonus points when using path / erode to ramp from the stolen creatures or cloudshift to permanently keep them.

Ashling, Flame Dancer /  Urabrask: Both not directly game ending, but will kill off small enemy creatures and add a lot of mana to snowball.

Goldspan Dragon / Storm-Kiln Artist: Since most instants are 1 mana, this usually results in playing every one of them each turn resulting in tons of triggers / draws. Untapping with that is often game ending.

Giggling Skitterspike: With a few counters either through its own abitlity or other triggers will quickly end the game.

Zada, Hedron Grinder / Mirrorwing Dragon: Draw spells will quickly go through the entire deck to fish for other wincons. Fists of Flame / Chandras Ignition also become winconditions.

Tokens: Obviously all cards creating tokens and buffing them are  a wincon itself.

"},{"attributes":{"bold":true},"insert":"Neat Interactions"},{"attributes":{"header":3},"insert":"
"},{"insert":"
If someone has a scary board, just intimidation bolt on feather to keep them from attacking on each of their turns.

Erode / Path to Exile can be used to ramp when used on your own tokens. Erode also works after making a creature indestructible.

"},{"attributes":{"bold":true},"insert":"More Build Options"},{"attributes":{"header":3},"insert":"
"},{"insert":"
In its current build the deck mainly tries to be consistent. This does mean the deck often works as intentend, but also that there are sometimes multiple draw / protection spells in hand that are not needed. 

The deck can easily remove 2-3 Cantrips, 2-3 Protection spells, 1-2 Ramp artifacts and even some token cards for more fun stuff. This can either be more interaction, so the deck can deal better with other decks or something else. It is even possible to build entirely around ETB effects and flickering. But keep in mind that consistency will go down. The Maybeboard has some cards that could work to get an idea. I would love to hear about some of your crazy ideas :)

"},{"attributes":{"bold":true},"insert":"Strengths"},{"attributes":{"header":3},"insert":"
"},{"insert":"
Feather is very resilient against most removal. "},{"attributes":{"list":"bullet"},"insert":"
"},{"insert":"Can pop off fairly consistently "},{"attributes":{"list":"bullet"},"insert":"
"},{"insert":"Usually does well in Creature heavy games"},{"attributes":{"list":"bullet"},"insert":"
"},{"insert":"
"},{"attributes":{"bold":true},"insert":"Weaknesses"},{"attributes":{"header":3},"insert":"
"},{"insert":"
Deck is built around feather, if he does not stick on the field the deck cannot function properly"},{"attributes":{"list":"bullet"},"insert":"
"},{"insert":"Light on interaction. There is not much removal, especially for artifacts / enchantments / Graveyards. If someone can set up their engines faster or has annoying stax pieces it can get dangerous fast"},{"attributes":{"list":"bullet"},"insert":"
"},{"insert":"Despite low cost of spells the deck is very mana hungry. Removal of mana rocks slows the deck down a lot."},{"attributes":{"list":"bullet"},"insert":"
"}]}
